log.msg: Agent B: Socket.changed(paths) built. Decides per path: not in this tab's resource entries -> ignore; in them and hot-swappable and a same-origin <link rel=stylesheet> matches -> bump ?t= on THAT element; anything else -> one reload(). $BLOCKRELOAD short-circuits the whole method (a swap changes the page under you too), not just the reload.

Agent B call: a path is NOT hot-swappable once any resource entry for it has initiatorType fetch/xmlhttprequest — ext/files and md.file() read sources as data, and swapping a <link> would leave that copy stale on screen. That is the 'unsure -> reload' fallback the brief asked for. Known gap logged: index.html itself is a navigation entry, not a resource entry, so editing it no longer reloads; noted in the readme rather than special-cased.

Server side built. Design call: the per-file byte offset always lands just past a newline, so an incomplete trailing line is simply left unread on disk rather than buffered in memory — every offset the server hands out is therefore a safe resume point, including across a server restart.
Live test: this line was appended while a ws client was subscribed — it should arrive as a jsonl message, with no reload.
verification A: this line was appended while a socket was subscribed — it must arrive as a jsonl message and reload nothing.
verification B: written in two writes — the half line must be held back until the newline lands.

Agent C: ext/JSONL/live.js built. Registry is Map(url-path -> Set of subscriptions), not one instance per path: the day board and a task page both read the same task.jsonl in one SPA session, and a single-entry map silently froze whichever registered first. Each streamed frame is skipped by an instance already past its offset — a second reader's replay-from-0 reaches the whole socket.

Agent C call: Tail.subscribe() answers a MISSING file with jsonl_reset, not an empty jsonl frame — so reset both resolves live()'s first-message promise and must NOT re-subscribe from 0 (subscribe->reset->subscribe is an infinite loop). Re-subscribe only when something had already streamed. Second call: a 1.5s deadline falls back to load() if the server answers nothing at all (a dev server predating Tail.js would otherwise hang the board forever).

Agent B verified in a real browser (playwright, live server on :80). Unknown path -> 0 navigations, 0 swaps. /styles.css -> ?t=1 then ?t=2 on the SAME element, 43 links before and after, 0 navigations, sheet stays at index 36 of 57. Routed a fake changed /styles.css body through playwright to prove content actually re-applies: body color went rgb(26,26,26) -> rgb(1,2,3) with no navigation. /framework/readme.md (fetched, not a link) -> reload. args [[null]] -> reload. $BLOCKRELOAD -> neither. 339 resource entries recorded with 0 bufferfull events, so setResourceTimingBufferSize is doing its job (default 250 would have dropped 89).

Agent B doc call: loaded() and restyle() are documented inside doc/method/changed.md rather than getting doc/method pages of their own — their meaning IS the decision changed() makes, and separate pages would put the @layer trap in three files. Recorded in doc/file/page.js.md so the omission is visible. Socket.js is 197 lines (over the ~100 guideline); splitting the trio into a sibling file would mean prototype-patching from outside, which is the black magic the house rules forbid — left whole, logged as improvement #5 in doc/file/Socket.js.md.
